description: This file contains a PHP class definition for EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator, which provides a decorator/wrapper around the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity, allowing additional methods such as retrieving formatted dates and setting termination reasons by ID.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides additional methods and functionalities around the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity, such as date formatting and setting reasons by ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeTerminationRecord instance.
